text:
Maya (Mkt): Heads-up — Nimbusecho case study: they can do a 30m interview next Tue 11am PT. Need legal on the quote and a transcript embargo until launch. cc @Sam (Legal) @Ava (Producer)
Ava (Producer): 11am PT works for me. Do we want recorded video + transcript or just audio?
Maya (Mkt): Video + transcript. We'll pull a short highlight clip for the launch post.
Jon (PM): Can we attach a short checklist for the interview? Timing, questions, and approval routing.
Ava (Producer): Yup — will run a 30m flow: 5m intros, 15m Qs, 5m raw quotes, 5m wrap. Sending draft questions now.
Maya (Mkt): Draft quote we want in the case: "Redwood made our inference costs predictable and cut latency by ~35% across our pipelines." Can legal take a look?
Sam (Legal): Please paste exact quote + who at Nimbusecho signed off. Legal TAT ~48h for redlines. If embargo, we need explicit date window.
Maya (Mkt): Quote author: Lina Torres (Head of ML Ops). Embargo: publish window May 6–8. Pasting quote below for quick copy: "Redwood made our inference costs predictable and cut latency by ~35% across our pipelines."
Ava (Producer): Lina also ok with headshot and short bio? We need release for asset usage.
Maya (Mkt): Lina said yes in principle — will send a release form.
Chad (Sales): Post-publish: can we route inbound leads from the case to the customer-success slate? Recommend tag `case:nimbusecho` in SFDC and add to the webinar invite list.
Jon (PM): Also, let's link this story to the benchmark narrative deck — helps sales with talking points.
Sam (Legal): Quick redline suggestion — swap "cut latency by ~35%" to "reduced latency by approximately 35%" for precision. Also need the signed customer release before we publish.
Maya (Mkt): Good call, Sam. I'll update the copy. Can we get legal sign-off by Thu EOD?
Sam (Legal): Aiming for Thu EOD; if Lina returns signed release by Wed, that helps.
Ava (Producer): Calendar invite: https://calendar.example.com/invite/abcd1234 — recording + Zoom link included. I'll upload recording to drive after call.
Maya (Mkt): Interview Qs (short list):
```
1) What problem were you trying to solve?
2) Why did you pick Redwood? Any alternatives evaluated?
3) What metrics moved after rollout (latency/cost/throughput)?
4) Any surprises during onboarding?
```
Ava (Producer): Also prepping a short 1-slide ask for the webinar team to reuse.
Chad (Sales): When case goes live, auto-send a one-pager to inbound leads and set lead source = "case_study". Can ops create a zap or SFDC workflow?
Maya (Mkt): I'll file a FR for ops. Tag to use: `case_nimbusecho` and pipeline: inbound->cs-review.
Sam (Legal): Confirming: once we have signed release + final quote wording, legal signs off. I will post redline comments in the doc.
reminder-bot: Reminder set — follow up with Lina for signed release in 48 hours. :alarm_clock:
Maya (Mkt): Thanks everyone. I'll upload the release and updated quote when Lina returns it. :thumbsup:
